_note: Stephen's own relationships with companies in the database. This is the multiplier that turns a feed into a briefing: a $40M round at a company he has never heard of is news, the same round at a company whose factory he walked through in July is an action. Nothing here can be derived from the data — it has to be told. Seeded 2026-08-19 from prior work; edit freely, it is read fresh every run.

_tiers.portfolio: The fund holds it, or a live deal is on the table. Anything that happens here is a position update.
_tiers.visited: Stephen has been on site or interviewed the founder. He can call them, and he has first-hand detail no competitor has.
_tiers.covered: Written about or scheduled for coverage. Warm, but at arm's length.
_tiers.il30: Auto-populated from INNOVATORS_LEAGUE_30 in data.js at runtime. Do not list here.

_beats._note: Live editorial threads. An event that lands on an open beat is worth more than the same event in isolation, because there is somewhere for it to go this week.
